messages:
maria: quick kickoff — summarizing PM follow-ups from the streaming postmortem. recurring tail pattern: timeouts at ~2500ms, partial responses when reconnect occurs, poor client backoff handling.
devon: thanks. do we have an owner list for the fixes?
maria: yes — propose triage + sprint owners. owners: reconnect logic (devon), client backoff docs (lee), server-side timeouts (kai), tracing/alerts (jamal).
lee: I'm fine with client backoff. I'll draft recommended config and example client snippet.
devon: i'll take reconnect logic. plan: implement idempotent resume token + jittered exponential backoff. target P0 for this sprint.
maria: timeline: 2-week remediation sprint starting Mon 1999-06-01. milestones:
- week1: prototyping + unit tests
- week2: rollout to canary + monitor 48h
owners will post daily standup notes here.
jamal: I'll wire a metric for 'partial_response_count' and add a high-priority alert if rate > 0.5% over 10m.
maria: docs link: https://go/reconnect-postmortem-actions (internal) — add JIRA refs in PRs. @devon please create the main ticket.
devon: created: INF-3720. PR will reference it.
lee: client snippet (draft):
```js
const backoff = (attempt) => Math.min(2000 * 2**attempt, 30000) + Math.floor(Math.random()*200);
// use resumeToken when reconnecting
client.connect({resumeToken})
```

keeping small max backoff to limit partial responses.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary/reconnect-fix -> 1999-06-08 03:00 UTC
oncall-bot: detected 3 partial response events in us-west-2 during last 6h — correlates with a deploy at 1999-05-28T22:40Z
maria: good catch — we'll gate canary with stricter trace sampling and the new metric. adding rollback window of 6h.
devon: action items assigned in INF-3720: reconnect impl (devon), client doc + example (lee), server timeout tuning (kai), alerting + dash (jamal). I'll kick off a design doc today.
lee: I'll post the client PR by EOD Wed.
kai: I will run a quick benchmark on the timeout config variants on a staging cluster and share results.
maria: thanks all. daily standups 10:30 PT. Please drop quick 1-line updates in this thread only.
devon: ack. starting work now.
maria: :thumbsup:
